name: Exterior Soffit Cleanup
intent: Final inspection + touch-up (qt_scaled), protection teardown at global 1000 SF/hr, equipment cleaning at global 10 min, site cleanup.
doctrine: NC cleanup. Final inspect qt_scaled (QT2:1500, QT3:800, QT4:350). Final touch-up qt_scaled (QT2:2000, QT3:1000, QT4:400). Protection teardown at global 1000 SF/hr. Equipment clean 10 min (global). Site cleanup 20 min.
